title: AFL Opening Round
metaDescription: AFL Opening Round: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Aussie Rules.

overview.about: Opening Round marks the start of the AFL season - a standalone first round scheduled to spotlight non-traditional football markets like New South Wales and Queensland before the main fixture begins. It launches the year's premiership race.
overview.nextEvent: The next AFL Opening Round kicks off the season with a selective set of fixtures, often in northern markets, ahead of the full Round 1. It is the first competitive football of the year after the pre-season.
